title: House Exterior Makeover Texas | Before & After Stone Upgrade
description: See how this Texas house exterior makeover transformed basic siding into a custom stone finish using Desert Sunrise panels. Real before & after.
text:
Texas House Exterior Makeover: From Basic Siding to Custom Stone
See how this Texas house exterior makeover transformed basic siding into a custom stone finish, no demolition or major construction required.

Hi, I’m Kristen, and I worked with this homeowner in Texas on a full exterior upgrade.

The home had solid structure, but the painted siding made it feel flat and a bit dated. It didn’t reflect the style or character the homeowner wanted and from the outside, it just didn’t stand out.

They weren’t interested in tearing everything off or starting a major renovation. They just wanted something that would dramatically improve the look and feel of the home without adding complexity. This project is a great example of how a house exterior makeover can completely change the look and feel of a home without a full remodel.

See What Your Home Could Look Like

Exterior Transformation with Stone Siding
From Basic Painted Siding to a Custom Stone Exterior Without Removing the Existing Structure

A simple material upgrade completely changed the feel of this home. Instead of replacing the entire exterior, we focused on installing stone siding to create a more substantial, high-end look.

✅ Installed directly over existing wood siding

✅ No demolition required

✅ Completed in days, not weeks

A Complete Exterior Transformation Without a Full Remodel
What once felt like a basic home now has the presence of a custom-built exterior.

Before

The Goal

- Exterior felt flat and outdated

- Needed more visual interest

- Didn’t reflect the homeowner’s style

- Wanted a more substantial, high-end appearance

- No interest in a full remodel

After

The Solution

- Add depth and texture across the entire exterior

- Create a natural stone appearance

- Completely change the visual weight of the home

- Modernize the look without structural changes

- Avoid the cost and complexity of masonry

What Does a House Exterior Makeover Like This Cost?

Most homeowners are surprised how affordable upgrades like this can be. Projects like this typically range between $6,000–$9,000, depending on the size of the home and layout.

Try Visualizer Get Your Project Estimate

Project Details

- Products Used: Panels, Corners

- Color: Desert Sunrise

- Install: Over Existing Siding

Will This Work Over Siding Like This Project?

Yes, GenStone can be installed over any flat surface.

Why Not Just Replace the Exterior?

That would add thousands in additional costs and GenStone is lightweight, so there’s no reason to remove the existing substrate.

Desert Sunrise Color Guide

This combination was chosen to bring warmth and contrast to the exterior while creating a natural stone look that complements the surrounding landscape.
